## Connection

Secure connect tokens, connecting, disconnecting and timeouts between a client and a server.

<!-- nova-work:connection:start -->

| feature | done |
|---|:---:|
| secure connect with a connect token | ✅ |
| a connect token admits one connection only | ✅ |
| client/server connection management | ✅ |
| connection request and connection timeouts | ✅ |
| disconnects carry a reason, on both sides | ✅ |
| client and server states match STATE-MACHINE.md | ✅ |
| loopback clients inside the server process | ❌ |
| connect handshake carries a schema vocabulary announcement | ❌ |
| complete | 75% |

[Source data](docs/roadmap.sexp)

<!-- nova-work:connection:end -->

## Messages

Channels of messages and data blocks sent over the connection.

| feature | done |
|---|:---:|
| reliable-ordered messages, resent until acked | ✅ |
| unreliable-unordered messages for time-sensitive data | ✅ |
| data blocks larger than a packet on reliable-ordered messages | ✅ |
| data blocks on unreliable-unordered messages | ✅ |
| multiple channels on one connection | ✅ |
| bitpacker and serialization system | ✅ |
| full send and receive queues fail cleanly | ✅ |
| complete | 100% |

## Library

Building, installing and embedding yojimbo, on every platform it supports.

<!-- nova-work:library:start -->

| feature | done |
|---|:---:|
| Linux, macOS and Windows | ✅ |
| startup refuses cleanly when an allocation fails | ✅ |
| one ABI across debug and release builds | ✅ |
| custom allocators, TLSF by default | ✅ |

| embeddable with add_subdirectory | ✅ |
| a netcode below the security floor is refused at configure time | ✅ |
| the wire builds with -ffp-contract=off on every target | ✅ |
| matcher: a sample web backend that issues connect tokens | ✅ |
| API documentation built on every change, warnings are errors | ✅ |
